title: Exclude distinct-mask Type B odd-idle unions
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** Fix the two Type B singleton odd idles of stage 8 at clocks 1339/1340 and the two of stage 9 at 2970/2971. A proposed single-role union keeps one old clock and removes the other. Four pairs give eight single and eight simultaneous disjoint-pair schedules. All 16 fail at q=+1 and unit body values. The four original projectors are distinct coordinate axes. Every simultaneous schedule has a nonzero stage derivative because the added and removed axes are disjoint. Zero unresolved within scope.

Across eight Type B ports, a rank-18 single fusion has optimistic gross upper 0.360623245857322 raw units. Two compatible pairs have upper 0.721246491714643. The optimistic rank-16 two-pair upper is 32.2769060131216, with signed phase and volume still to prove. Both complete fixed-target margins are negative. No saving is realized.

## Task and overlap

Use [#7334](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7334) at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with signed [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. [#7295](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7295) bounds rank-additive shared groups and supplies the contact inventory. This package checks exact fixed-clock odd/odd support, including every disjoint two-pair schedule. [#7380](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7380) handles odd/even unions. The package is the only new commit, stacked on two existing [#7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257) CI commits.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-type-b-odd-odd-idle-bound/replay.py
```

The clean replay regenerates the complete signed quote and two independent exact derivative receipts. All 16 schedule witnesses agree and four altered-input controls reject. Registered replay, committed bytes and modes, source history, navigation and official Git-free export passed locally. The failed necessary condition stopped full signed-body and physical candidate verification.

## Credit

#7295 supplies the rank-additive price bound and role trace, #7357 the idle stock and impulse routines, #7315 the projector precedent, #7356/#7360/#7380 the related fixed-clock scopes, #7334 and #7113 the literal inputs, and #7298 the directed tariff. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

A provider with two independently restored returns would need a new signed interface and complete volume and routing price. First bound the full-width sign-displacement requirement on one exact pair before testing another site.
